title: Bind native auditor evidence and isolate hosted runner transport
body:
Audit acceptance now binds the admitted native auditor, original streams, reports, source subjects and retained artifacts. Missing, changed or incomplete observations refuse; failure artifacts preserve the primary outcome. Audit capture uses the Rust helper through canonical dispatchers.

Hosted tests previously inherited GitHub Runner.Worker IPC pipes and correctly failed descriptor admission. The CI launcher now marks only the observed, identity-matched channel pair close-on-exec; unrelated descriptors and the native hostile-descriptor tests remain unchanged. Bounded failure diagnostics retain metadata without descriptor contents or credentials.

Validation on f6033ea: canonical local required lane passed 62 fast and 271 contract tests, lint, security, docs and corpus replay. Push and PR required workflows both passed. Four actual fork/exec tests cover eight transport scenarios. Historical failed runs are retained.

This is component/CI acceptance. It does not qualify a signed auditor distribution, installed coding service, provider execution or complete product release. Independent review remains required before integration.

title: Authorise workspace cleanup by its preservation receipt, not by an ended lease
body:
## The defect

Every completed attempt preserved its Candidate and then failed. The Runner releases its lease as `Succeeded` before asking gitd to delete the workspace — an order pinned by a simulation test, so that a crash between the two leaves a recorded Candidate rather than an unaccounted workspace. Cleanup then took a Kernel mutation permit like any other write, and minting one performs an online lease and fence read-back that the release has just made impossible.

Reproduced three ways: on the simulator, on the retained real Claude recording, and this morning through the real dispatch path (farmd + production gitd + the product Runner), whose journal reads `candidate_prepared` → `candidate_preserved` → `released: succeeded` → `terminated: GITD_REFUSED` with `AUTHORITY_REFUSED: online lease/fence read-back refused … no active lease`.

The Runner's own source named this a known contradiction and said the resolution belonged here, because cleanup is documented as receipt-gated.

## The change

`handle_cleanup` verifies the session token, refuses a frozen daemon, then calls the new `PreservationAuthority::authorize_receipt` **before any reservation** — seal, state digest, cleanup target, destination identity, artifact shape, salvaged objects, bundle and artifact digest. It reserves through the new `authorize_by_preservation_receipt`, which computes the same transport fingerprint as the Kernel path and builds a complete `MutationSubject` from the receipt digest, the operation and the session's exact writer incarnation, but consults no online checker. Settlement is recorded in the durable mutation ledger with no Kernel round trip; an indeterminate outcome still freezes the daemon.

Every other operation keeps the Kernel permit path unchanged, and those signatures are untouched.

## Proof

- `cargo test --locked -p bullet-gitd -p bullet-git-workspace` — 171 passed, 0 failed
- `cargo test --locked --all-features -p bullet-gitd` — 72 passed, 0 failed
- `cargo clippy --locked … --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check` — clean

Eleven new tests: cleanup succeeds against a checker that can issue no permit while another operation on the same daemon still refuses `AUTHORITY_CONTRACT_UNAVAILABLE`; garbage, empty, byte-tampered and foreign-session receipts each refuse `PRESERVATION_RECEIPT_REFUSED`, leave the session usable, and the real receipt then still cleans up; reservation replay returns the durable result and never a second permit; a mismatching replay refuses `AUTHORITY_REPLAY_CONFLICT`; a post-permit repository failure still yields `MUTATION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` and freezes.

## Not in this PR

The matching Runner change (stop minting a permit for cleanup; report a post-preservation cleanup failure as `WORKSPACE_ORPHANED_AFTER_PRESERVATION` naming the candidate, receipt and destination) is prepared as a reviewed patch and handed to the kernel's integrator, whose tree is frozen for a qualification window. `apply_change` still consumes its permit before repository validation; closing that needs a read-only validator in files outside this change's scope.

title: Raise Jankurai above 90 without lowering floors
body:
## Summary
- Raise the local Jankurai 1.6.11 `--full` score above 90 with zero applied caps and zero hard findings.
- Keep fuzz C outputs under the skipped repo-root `target/` so the auditor cannot cap the score.

## Test plan
- [x] `jankurai audit . --full --no-score-history --fail-under 90 --fail-on critical --fail-on high` → 92, caps `[]`, hard 0
- [x] `bash scripts/ci-local.sh required` → pass
- Hosted GitHub Actions are absent from this snapshot: the OAuth token cannot push `.github/workflows`. Local required + audit are the merge gate.
